name: MLE-bench
titleZh: MLE-bench：评测机器学习工程中的 AI 智能体
summary: 75 Kaggle competitions with human medal thresholds taken from public leaderboards, used to score agents on real ML engineering work.
summaryZh: 75 场 Kaggle 竞赛，以公开排行榜上的人类奖牌线为基线，用来给智能体在真实机器学习工程上打分。
keyFact: MLE-bench (Chan et al., arXiv:2410.07095, 2024-10-09) curated 75 Kaggle competitions and found the best setup, o1-preview with AIDE scaffolding, reached at least Kaggle bronze level in 16.9% of them.
keyFactZh: MLE-bench（Chan 等，arXiv:2410.07095，2024-10-09）整理 75 场 Kaggle 竞赛，发现最佳组合（o1-preview 配 AIDE 脚手架）在其中 16.9% 的竞赛里达到至少铜牌水平。
whyItMatters: Medal thresholds give an interpretable yardstick that a bare percentage never does.
whyItMattersZh: 用奖牌线作标尺，比一个光秃秃的百分比更容易理解。
title: MLE-bench: Evaluating Machine Learning Agents on Machine Learning Engineering
